cd /app && python3 << 'EOF'
import json
from language import load, validate
text=open('/app/witness.json').read()
print("file bytes:", len(text.encode('utf-8')), "(limit 65536)")
p=load(text)
# count nodes + depth via validate (returns count)
print("AST nodes:", validate(p), "(limit 512)")
# depth check
def depth(e, d=0):
    if isinstance(e, list):
        if not e: return d
        return max(depth(x, d+1) for x in e)
    return d
print("body depth:", depth(p['body']), "(limit 32)")
print("max block len:", max(len(b) for b in [p['body'], p['body'][2][2]]), "(limit 128)")
EOF
